rationale: The report captures all of the reported items from the input, but severely over-elaborates and hallucinates many actions, causes, and statuses not present in the supervisor notes (e.g., inventing that production was halted, creating detailed statuses and pending tasks out of thin air). The compressor severity is ranked HIGH without justification, and while readability is excellent, accuracy suffers badly due to numerous fabrications.
